{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_data['revenue'] = sales_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_data = sales_data[sales_data['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the cross-tabulation again to confirm confounding
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_data['channel'], sales_data['customer_segment']))"}
